objective: Upgrade Greywake's ocean, water interactions, vessels and water effects to a premium visual experience.

Persistent curved wakes, propeller wash, waterline foam, local waves and impacts that survive movement and origin rebasing
Damped heave/pitch/roll from multiple hull samples, wave-triggered bow spray, wet hull/deck materials
Actual hit positions, distinct shell/torpedo/depth-charge effects, sinking turbulence and bubbles
Refraction, underwater surface optics, filtered light, bubbles and smooth surface transitions
Distinct calm/swell/storm states with wind direction, foam and spray responding to the sea
Quality scaling, both rendering backends, standalone offline build, existing functionality and meaningful tests
Inspect actual rendered calm/rough/turning/dive/impact scenes and repair visual defects
